subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime schema and its CLI, Gateway, context-reference, and native-protocol surfaces as a permanent core contract on the 2026.7.1 release line?
rationale: Implementation review can assess correctness, but it cannot authorize a new persistent data model and cross-surface public contract with long-term migration, support, and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Adopt the durable runtime as core after the exact-head defect, proof, upgrade, and scope gates are satisfied.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Retain only the shared persistence and lifecycle primitives while deferring CLI, Gateway, native-client, and broader delivery integration.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Do not adopt the new durable-core contract on this release line and re-scope or close the dependent stack.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the durable runtime as core after the exact-head defect, proof, upgrade, and scope gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-main ownership signal is recent work on the shared SQLite database that would own the permanent persisted contract.
